messages:
anjali: quick q — when we click 'save view' on a per-model tab, should the default snapshot be compact or full? compact saves smaller telemetry but sometimes misses model-specific pins.

kevin: I thought we landed on compact by default to avoid token cost blowups. :money_with_wings:

maria: compact is fine for previews but ops wants full for audit/history. can we make it tiered?

julian: proposal: compact by default, add "snapshot_mode": "full" when user checks "preserve traffic/sample", and preserved snapshots go to long-retention bucket with quota cost bump. API example:

```
POST /api/saved_views
{
  "scope": "model",
  "model_id": "redwood/large-v1",
  "snapshot_mode": "compact" // or "full"
}
```

anjali: how do we show quota cost in the console at the click moment? need a quick affordance.

kevin: we have cost_estimate endpoint already. we can call it client-side with the current sample size.

maria: also need routing hint: saved view should pin routing policy by default to avoid later drift (e.g., pinned_model_route: true). else saved queries become non-deterministic.

julian: agree. but that can inflate reserved capacity. maybe add "pin_hint" that's advisory (doesn't force Dedicated).

ops-bot: DevOps note: ensure changing snapshot_mode doesn't bypass retention SLA for Private deployments.

anjali: ok action items: kevin to add client-side cost peek, julian to update API contract with snapshot_mode & pin_hint, maria to draft UX copy for cost/retention warning. I'll follow up in product doc.

kevin: ack. will add a small debounce on the cost call. estimate API already supports sample_size param.

maria: will write copy and propose microcopy variations.

anjali: thanks all :thumbsup:
